title: Little moments while the character works alone (meditating, training, gathering, crafting)
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

c_1.text: You find a perfect shard of mithril, its blue glint catching the torchlight.

c_2.text: You find the right combination of minerals to temper the blade, sparks flying in a cold dawn.

c_3.text: You smooth the last edge of the jade pendant, feeling the coolness of your work.

items.text: You find a glowing emerald embedded in the wall, its light dancing with the flicker of your torch.

c_2.text: You hammer out a chime, its tone resonant with inner peace.

c_3.text: You smooth the final edges on a set of iron armor, feeling the cold metal warm under your practiced hands.

c_2.text: You hammer out a sturdy blade, the heat from the forge seeping into your bones.

items.text: Your breath mists in the cold as you sit beneath the stone arch, feeling the nanites hum quietly inside your blood.
The cold wind bites your cheeks as you meditate by the fire.
Mist rolls thick over Eliet valley, hiding the path to the sleeping tortoise beneath Shellhaven.
You sit with Elder Mo, breathing slow while nanites in your blood warm your skin.
You sit in silence while your blood hums quietly.
The frost on your eyelashes melts as you hold still, feeling the nanites in your blood settle into a quiet rhythm.
You sit in the cold dark and tune your nanites to feel the sleeping tortoise's heartbeat.

items.m_1: The cold wind bites Eliet's cheeks as you finish your morning meditation.
items.t_1: Your sword feels heavier today, the steel humming faintly with nanite heat.
items.g_1: You found three water lilies near the stream where the elders say they grow.
items.c_1: Smith Hale hammered the iron ring until it matched the shape of your palm.
